title: MT41033: Mineral And Particle Technology
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Prerequisite - NilCurrent Trends in Particle Technology; Minerals
classifications, dissolution, adsorption, precipitation, rheology of
suspensions and particulate matter; Particle Sampling; Particle Size Estimation
and Distributions; Particle Size Reduction and Energy Requirement: design of
size reduction processes, energy for size reduction - work index; Crushers
design and operation; Grinders design and operation; Screening: design,
operation, capacity and efficiency; Classification: design and operation of
mechanical, centrifugal and hydro cyclones; Solid - Liquid Separation: design
and operation of thickeners, flocculation, filters; Gravity Separation:
particle settling rate, design and operations of jigging, shaking
concentrators, flowing film concentrators, dense media separation; Flotation:
principle of flotation, flotation reagents, equipments, circuits and kinetics;
Magnetic, tribo-electric, electrostatic separation methods; use of microwave
and, ultrasound technology in mineral and particulate system; Surface and
colloidal phenomena in particle processing: electrical double layer; Low cost
processing of ultra-fine particle by colloidal and thermo-chemical based
methods; Mathematical modeling of mineral processing; Atomistic based
simulation in mineral processing; Mineral Process Control; Environmental
issues: waste recycling, hazards in particulate handling.Text books: 1.Ashok
Gupta and Denis Yan: Mineral Processing Design and Operation: An Introduction,
ISBN: 978-0-444-51636-7, Elsevier Science, 2006.2.J. Lyklema: Particulate
Colloids : Fundamentals of Interface and Colloid Science (Fundamentals of
Interface and Colloid Science), ISBN-10: 012460529X, Academic Press; 1st
edition, 2005.
